boundary: Typed presentation and official AG-UI transport only. Execution checks actual managed model and canonical ownership in the live browser; critical checks adverse events and actual same-identity replay/auth denial. Controlled owner ports test disclosure guards, not canonical persistence. Command mediation, native examiners, cyclic verification and overall A1 acceptance remain separate open requirements.
